title: Constructible modules on the pro-étale site
statement:
Let $\mathcal A$ be a closed symmetric monoidal Grothendieck abelian category whose tensor product is additive, and let $X$ be a scheme. Give $\Sh(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal A)$ the sheaf tensor product of [sk-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor], on the small pro-étale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $\mathcal R$ be a ring object [sk-def-sfb-ring-object] of this category and let $M$ be a left $\mathcal R$-module object [sk-def-sfb-module-objects].

For a morphism $g\colon Z\to X$, write $g^*$ for the pullback of sheaves [def-sfb-finite-upper-star], with its strong monoidal structure [def-sfb-finite-upper-star-monoidal]. Write $\operatorname{mapMod}(g^*)$ for the transport of module objects [sk-def-sfb-transport]; it sends $M$ to a module over the pulled-back ring object $g^*\mathcal R$.

The module $M$ is *constructible* if there is a finite stratification of $X$ [def-constructible-stratification], with strata realized by immersions $g_a\colon X_a\to X$, such that, for every $a$, the $g_a^*\mathcal R$-module $\operatorname{mapMod}(g_a^*)(M)$ is locally finitely presented over $g_a^*\mathcal R$ [def-sfb-locally-finitely-presented].
